notes.title: New Game Plus update!
notes.content:
[url=https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/2016/12/03/best-rpg-2016/]Rock Paper Shotgun's RPG of the year 2016[/url] has just got bigger! 

Enter a cloud save from a finished Part 4 game into Part 1 to unlock New Game Plus mode. New Game Plus ups the difficulty, toughens the enemies, adds some more magic items earlier on - and, of course, includes a few new secrets to be dug up.

[url=http://www.inklestudios.com/2016/12/22/the-adventures-begin-again.html]Read more about New Game Plus mode here.[/url]

Happy adventuring!
